literal: From goodness of mind will happen the next life; moreover, that too from goodness of company possesses strength.
translation: A good future life is achieved through goodness of mind; moreover, even that goodness is strengthened by the goodness of one's company.
modern: ஒருவனுக்கு மறுமை இன்பம் அவனது மனநலத்தால் உண்டாகும்; அந்த மனநலமும் அவன் சேர்ந்திருக்கும் நல்லினத்தின் நன்மையால் மேலும் வலிமை பெறும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the relationship between a pure mind and good company. While a good mind secures well-being in the future life, that very goodness of mind is reinforced and protected by associating with good people. The word 'ஏமாப்பு' means strength or security, highlighting that even internal virtue requires the external support of good company to remain steadfast.
